#[repr(align(64))]
struct Aligned(u8);

fn main() {
    let mut slots = Box::<[ELEMENT]>::new_uninit_slice(LENGTH);
    // If allocation unexpectedly succeeds, make the storage observable.
    std::hint::black_box(slots.as_mut_ptr());
    slots[0].write(VALUE);
    println!("unexpected allocation success {}", slots.len());
}
